title: Armour
summary: Every armour set with its pieces, stats and set bonus.

s.x: Armour comes in sets of four pieces. Wearing all four gives the set bonus. Each set is listed with its bonus, then its pieces from helmet to boots.
Set bonus (4 pieces): Patient Hands. +10 Fishing Speed.
